 Real Betis host Feyenoord in the third round of the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League league phase on Wednesday 21 October 2026. Kick-off is at 19:00 UK time at the Estadio La Cartuja de Sevilla in Seville.
 Real Betis have won both of their opening European matches, beating Lille and Porto 3-2, while Feyenoord bounced back from a heavy defeat to Barcelona with a victory over Como.
 Read on for our sports betting tips and analysis, as well as the expected lineups and where to watch this game.

 Real Betis vs. Feyenoord - Head-to-head record
 Real Betis and Feyenoord have met just once in European competition. That encounter came in the 2025-26 Europa League league phase, when Betis claimed a 2-1 victory .
 Although the sample is limited, the Spanish side can also point to a strong record against Dutch opposition, having won four, drawn one and lost one of their six European matches against clubs from the Netherlands. Feyenoord, meanwhile, have won only three of their 12 matches in Spain, losing eight.
 These records favour the hosts, although both teams’ current form and attacking strengths will be important factors in Wednesday’s encounter.

 Real Betis - Looking to bounce back
 Let’s take a closer look at Real Betis’ current form. In the following sections, we will analyse their momentum, recent results, and tactical setup before looking at the probable Real Betis vs. Feyenoord line-ups.
 Recent form
 Real Betis will be keen to respond after a 5-2 home defeat to Barcelona in La Liga. Despite that setback, Manuel Pellegrini’s side have made an encouraging start to the campaign, winning eight of their 11 matches in all competitions.
 Their European form has been particularly strong, with victories over Lille and Porto both ending 3-2. Six points from their first two matches have put Betis in a promising position in the Champions League league phase.
 However, Betis will have to manage several absences. Junior Firpo and Cucho Hernandez are ruled out, while Aitor Ruibal is a doubt. Troy Parrott is expected to lead the attack in Hernandez’s absence, with Antony also in contention to start.

 Feyenoord - Riding a wave of victories
 Let’s look at Feyenoord’s current situation. We will analyse their impressive run of form, recent results, and the standout players for their trip to Spain.
 Recent form
 Feyenoord travel to Seville after winning their last five matches in all competitions . Their recent domestic performances have been particularly impressive, including 7-0 and 5-0 victories, although their latest outing was a tighter 4-3 win over Telstar.
 Their Champions League campaign has been more uneven. A 5-1 defeat away to Barcelona in their opening match exposed defensive weaknesses, but they responded with a 3-2 home victory over Como. Feyenoord have therefore collected three points from their first two European fixtures.
 The visitors will be without several players, including Goncalo Borges, Jordan Bos, Jakub Moder, Reiss Nelson, Bart Nieuwkoop, Gijs Smal and Shaqueel van Persie. Gjivai Zechiel, Anis Hadj Moussa and Nacho Ferri are expected to feature in attacking roles.

 Predictions for Real Betis vs. Feyenoord - A high-scoring affair
 Real Betis have scored three goals in each of their first two Champions League matches, demonstrating their attacking potential. Feyenoord have also been prolific, despite the 5-1 loss to Barcelona. Our first prediction is over 0.5 goals in the first half .
 Both teams have shown they can create and convert chances, while Feyenoord’s defensive record in Europe suggests that Betis should find opportunities. With attacking quality on both sides, we predict no draw at half-time .
 Our main prediction is for a winner and over 2.5 goals . Betis have home advantage and a perfect European record so far, but Feyenoord’s recent scoring form could make this a competitive encounter.
